renewal_fiscal_comparison.assumption: Matched 0/1/2 full-output factories in E and refusal. All reference workers come from previously idle domestic labor, so full factory payroll tax is incremental. Factories pay for their own energy; government only books E purchases and E sales, never deducts private energy costs twice. Refusal uses maritime energy privately, outside government budget. Excludes construction, subsidy and migration costs equally from both sides; this is a recurring-flow comparison, not a feasible investment timeline or B15. Renewed aid is assumed through M24 without any unconfirmed W fee; W effects on water/targets are not simulated.
